# JitterPlotElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The spread of individual points (strip / jitter plot, with box or violin overlay)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasJitterPlotExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasJitterPlotExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasRidgelineChartProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRidgelineChartProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasErrorBarsProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasErrorBarsProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChartProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChartProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement> CreateJitterPlotElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement> CreateJitterPlotWithCategories( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::vector<std::string>& categories, const std::string& title = "");   // Helper factory for jitter plot with basic configuration
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasJitterPlotElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `JitterDistribution`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Uniform` | Rectangular spread (default) - uses uniform random |
| `Gaussian` | Circular/normal spread - uses Box-Muller transform |
| `Beeswarm` | Beeswarm packing (swarm, center, hex, square) |

### enum `JitterRepresentationMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `IndividualPoints` | Each dot = one data point (default) |
| `CountMode` | Dot size/count represents aggregation |

### enum `JitterHybridMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `JitterOnly` | Pure jitter plot (default) |
| `JitterBoxPlot` | Jitter + box plot overlay |
| `JitterBarChart` | Jitter + bar chart base |
| `JitterViolinPlot` | Jitter + violin plot |
| `RaincloudPlot` | Half-violin + jitter horizontal |

### enum `StatisticalMarkerStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `MedianLine` | Horizontal line at median (most common) |
| `MeanPoint` | Point/diamond at mean |
| `MeanLine` | Horizontal line at mean |
| `QuartileLines` | Lines at Q1, Q2 (median), Q3 |
| `BoxPlotOverlay` | Full box plot with whiskers |

### enum `AxisScale`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Linear` | Standard linear scale (default) |
| `Logarithmic` | Log10 scale for exponential data |
| `SymmetricLog` | Symmetric log (handles negative values) |

### enum `MeanMarkerShape`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Diamond` | Diamond symbol (default) |
| `Cross` | Plus/cross symbol (✚) |
| `Circle` | Filled circle |
| `Square` | Filled square |
| `Star` | Star symbol |

### enum `CategoryLabelPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bottom` | Below chart (default) |
| `Top` | Above chart |
| `Both` | Mirror labels top and bottom |

### enum `BeeswarmMethod`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Swarm` | Greedy swarm placement (default) |
| `Center` | Symmetric center layout |
| `Hex` | Hexagonal grid |
| `Square` | Square grid |

### enum `BeeswarmPriority`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Ascending` | Smallest values first (default) |
| `Descending` | Largest values first |
| `Random` | Random order |
| `Compact` | Tightest fit first |
| `Dense` | Highest local density first |

### enum `BeeswarmCorral`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoneCorral` | No constraint (default; not named None: X11's macro) |
| `Open` | Allow escape with warning |
| `Wrap` | Wrap points to opposite side |
| `Clamp` | Force within bounds |

### enum `BeeswarmSide`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Both` | Spread both directions (default) |
| `Left` | Force left side only |
| `Right` | Force right side only |

### enum `JitterPointSizeMode`

NEW in 1.3.0: how a point's radius is derived.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Fixed` | Every point uses pointSize (default, 1.1 behaviour) |
| `ByValue` | Area proportional to the point's entry in JitterCategoryData::sizeValues |

### enum `JitterPointColorMode`

NEW in 1.3.0: how a point's fill color is derived.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ByCategory` | Category / hue group color (default, 1.1 behaviour) |
| `ByValue` | Continuous colormap over JitterCategoryData::colorValues |

### struct `JitterCategoryData`

Category data container for jitter plots
